findings.issue: Value generator can emit values that violate stated constraints. (a) Password: the 'Aa1' / '!' complexity suffix is added before pw[:hi] truncation, so a small maxlength drops the digit/symbol (verified: maxlength=6 gives no digit; hi<8 gives a sub-8 password). (b) Password has no 128 cap when a retry min exceeds 128 (verified 200 chars returned for 'at least 200'). (c) no_symbol retry only skips appending '!', but the base token_urlsafe password still contains '-' and '_', so an 'only letters and numbers' error can never be fixed by retry. (d) Username from an existing .env.test (line 128) is not normalized: 'Ab-C' is emitted as-is, violating [a-z0-9_]; username is also not lowercased or stripped of bad chars before truncation.
findings.fix_hint: Build the password to fit: clamp lo/hi to [8,128], ensure complexity classes within the first hi chars (truncate base first, then force-include upper/lower/digit by overwriting trailing chars), and when no_symbol strip non-alphanumerics from the base. Sanitize username with re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9_]','',u.lower()) and pad/truncate to 3-24 intersected with field limits. Add unit tests for maxlength<10, no_symbol, and a dirty seed username.

findings.issue: Required radio groups and required unmapped 'other' fields are skipped, so such forms stall until validation_failed.
findings.fix_hint: Select the first radio of a required group; follow-up acceptable.

findings.issue: adjust_from_errors regexes are loose: 'already' / 'min.' / 'max.' can match inside unrelated words, and 'regen' triggers on any error containing 'already' or 'registered' (e.g. a password message).
findings.fix_hint: Use word boundaries and require 'user'/'email' scope for regen.
